# Git, review and release

How changes reach main and how releases are cut.

| Rule | Level | Applies to | Verified |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [KB-GIT-001](#kb-git-001) Every commit is signed off (DCO) | must | all | checked |
| [KB-GIT-002](#kb-git-002) Changes reach main only through a pull request that passes the CI gate | must | all | checked |
| [KB-GIT-003](#kb-git-003) Release tags are immutable | must | all | checked |
| [KB-GIT-004](#kb-git-004) The changelog names every release | must | all | planned |

## KB-GIT-001: Every commit is signed off (DCO) { #kb-git-001 }

**MUST** · all · since 1.0

Every commit in a pull request carries a `Signed-off-by:` line that matches its author.

*Verified by:*

- `dco` (implemented): every commit of a pull request has a Signed-off-by line matching its author

*Explained in:* [standards/repo-governance.md](../standards/repo-governance.md)

## KB-GIT-002: Changes reach main only through a pull request that passes the CI gate { #kb-git-002 }

**MUST** · all · since 1.0

main accepts squash merges of pull requests whose single required check, `CI gate / gate`, passed; no direct pushes, no
force-pushes, linear history.

*Verified by:*

- `ci-gate` (implemented): one required check that passes only when every job of the workflow passed
- `rulesets` (implemented): branch and tag rulesets as declared in .github/org/rulesets (PR only, linear history, tags
  kept)

*See also:* [ADR-0015](../adr/0015-solo-maintainer-governance.md); IEC 62304:2006+A1:2015 8.2 (change control)


## KB-GIT-003: Release tags are immutable { #kb-git-003 }

**MUST** · all · since 1.0

A `vX.Y.Z` tag is never moved or deleted; a mistake gets a new version.

*Verified by:*

- `rulesets` (implemented): branch and tag rulesets as declared in .github/org/rulesets (PR only, linear history, tags
  kept)

*See also:* IEC 62304:2006+A1:2015 8.1.1 (identification of configuration items)


## KB-GIT-004: The changelog names every release { #kb-git-004 }

!!! note "Proposed"

    Enforced in ci-tools today; the reusable check for every repository is planned.

**MUST** · all · since 1.0 · enforced from 2027-01-15

CHANGELOG.md follows Keep a Changelog; a release is cut by adding its dated `[X.Y.Z]` section, the next SemVer step, in
the pull request that releases it.

*Verified by:*

- `changelog` (planned): CHANGELOG.md follows Keep a Changelog; a new version section is the next SemVer step, dated,
  not empty

*Explained in:* [standards/release.md](../standards/release.md)
